<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1">
<title>Prof. Ts. Dr. Zurina Zainal Abidin — Biochemical & Bioseparation Engineering</title>
<meta name="description" content="Professor of Chemical and Environmental Engineering, Universiti Putra Malaysia. Turning bio-resources into membranes, sensors, bio-based materials and clean water technology.">
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com">
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com" crossorigin>
<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Fraunces:opsz,wght@9..144,300;9..144,400;9..144,600;9..144,700&family=Karla:wght@300;400;500;600;700&family=IBM+Plex+Mono:wght@400;500;600&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
<style>
:root{
  --ink:#14261F;
  --body-tx:#3C4E46;
  --muted:#6B7D74;
  --bg:#F4F7F2;
  --white:#FFFFFF;
  --line:rgba(20,38,31,.14);
  --line-2:rgba(20,38,31,.08);

  --c-dep:#5B3FD6;
  --c-poly:#12A05B;
  --c-cdot:#D6218C;
  --c-water:#0796B0;
  --c-sep:#DE8306;
  --c-edu:#E24B36;

  --acc:#DE8306;
  --acc2:#0796B0;

  --max:1180px;
  --disp:"Fraunces",Georgia,serif;
  --body:"Karla",system-ui,sans-serif;
  --mono:"IBM Plex Mono",ui-monospace,monospace;
}
*{box-sizing:border-box}
html{scroll-behavior:smooth}
body{margin:0;background:var(--bg);color:var(--body-tx);
  font-family:var(--body);font-size:19px;line-height:1.65;-webkit-font-smoothing:antialiased}
img{max-width:100%;display:block}
a{color:inherit}
button{font-family:inherit}

.wrap{max-width:var(--max);margin:0 auto;padding:0 28px;position:relative;z-index:2}
.eyebrow{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:12.5px;letter-spacing:.18em;text-transform:uppercase;
  color:var(--acc);margin:0 0 18px;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;font-weight:600}
.eyebrow::before{content:"";width:26px;height:3px;background:var(--acc);flex:none;border-radius:3px}

h1,h2,h3,h4{font-family:var(--disp);font-weight:400;margin:0;line-height:1.08;
  letter-spacing:-.015em;color:var(--ink)}
h2{font-size:clamp(34px,5vw,58px);margin-bottom:16px}
h3{font-size:clamp(22px,2.7vw,29px);line-height:1.22}
p{margin:0 0 16px}
.lede{font-size:clamp(19px,2.1vw,23px);max-width:62ch;color:var(--body-tx)}

section{padding:96px 0;position:relative}
.tint{background:var(--white)}

.tool,.specimens,.rows,.stack,.journey,.links,.metrics{position:relative;z-index:2}

/* section washes */
#spotlight{background:linear-gradient(160deg,#F3EFFF 0%,#EAF7F8 55%,#FFF6E8 100%)}
#ip{background:#FFF7EA}
#ip .eyebrow,#ip .eyebrow::before{color:var(--c-cdot)}
#ip .eyebrow::before{background:var(--c-cdot)}
#contact{background:linear-gradient(150deg,#FFF1DA,#FDE7F2)}
#teaching .eyebrow{color:var(--c-edu)}
#teaching .eyebrow::before{background:var(--c-edu)}
#publications .eyebrow{color:var(--c-dep)}
#publications .eyebrow::before{background:var(--c-dep)}
#group .eyebrow{color:var(--c-poly)}
#group .eyebrow::before{background:var(--c-poly)}


/* hero */
.hero{position:relative;padding:70px 0 0;overflow:hidden;background:var(--white)}
.hero::before{content:"";position:absolute;inset:-30% -10% auto -10%;height:150%;
  background:radial-gradient(50% 55% at 78% 32%,rgba(222,131,6,.20),transparent 68%),
             radial-gradient(45% 50% at 12% 12%,rgba(91,63,214,.14),transparent 70%),
             radial-gradient(60% 60% at 55% 100%,rgba(7,150,176,.16),transparent 70%)}
.herogrid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.25fr .85fr;gap:56px;align-items:end}
.hero h1{font-size:clamp(34px,5.4vw,74px);font-weight:300;line-height:1.05;
  letter-spacing:-.03em}
.hero h1 em{font-style:italic;background:linear-gradient(92deg,var(--c-sep),var(--c-cdot));
  -webkit-background-clip:text;background-clip:text;color:transparent}
.rank{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:12.5px;letter-spacing:.18em;text-transform:uppercase;
  color:var(--c-dep);margin:0 0 22px;font-weight:600}
.role{font-size:21px;color:var(--body-tx);max-width:46ch;margin:26px 0 0}
.feedstock{margin:30px 0 0;font-family:var(--mono);font-size:13.5px;letter-spacing:.04em;
  color:var(--muted);line-height:2.2}
.feedstock b{color:var(--ink);font-weight:600;background:linear-gradient(transparent 62%,rgba(222,131,6,.28) 62%)}
.feedstock .arw{color:var(--c-cdot);padding:0 8px;font-weight:700}
.portrait{position:relative;margin-bottom:-2px;display:flex;justify-content:flex-end;align-items:flex-end}
.portrait img{width:auto;max-height:500px;max-width:100%;border-radius:8px 8px 0 0;
  mask-image:linear-gradient(to bottom,#000 80%,transparent 100%);
  -webkit-mask-image:linear-gradient(to bottom,#000 80%,transparent 100%)}

.metrics{border-top:2px solid var(--ink);margin-top:44px;display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(6,1fr)}
.metric{padding:26px 18px 30px;border-right:1px solid var(--line);position:relative}
.metric:last-child{border-right:0}
.metric b{display:block;font-family:var(--disp);font-size:42px;font-weight:400;line-height:1}
.metric:nth-child(1) b{color:var(--c-dep)}
.metric:nth-child(2) b{color:var(--c-cdot)}
.metric:nth-child(3) b{color:var(--c-water)}
.metric:nth-child(4) b{color:var(--c-poly)}
.metric:nth-child(5) b{color:var(--c-sep)}
.metric:nth-child(6) b{color:var(--c-edu)}
.metric span{display:block;font-family:var(--mono);font-size:11px;letter-spacing:.13em;
  text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--muted);margin-top:9px;line-height:1.5}

/* specimen cards */
.specimens{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(320px,1fr));gap:22px;margin-top:48px}
.spec{background:var(--white);border:1px solid var(--line-2);border-radius:10px;overflow:hidden;
  display:flex;flex-direction:column;box-shadow:0 1px 2px rgba(20,38,31,.05);
  transition:transform .35s cubic-bezier(.2,.7,.3,1),box-shadow .35s}
.spec::before{content:"";display:block;height:5px}
.spec:nth-child(1)::before{background:var(--c-dep)}
.spec:nth-child(2)::before{background:var(--c-poly)}
.spec:nth-child(3)::before{background:var(--c-cdot)}
.spec:nth-child(4)::before{background:var(--c-water)}
.spec:nth-child(5)::before{background:var(--c-sep)}
.spec:nth-child(6)::before{background:var(--c-edu)}
.spec:nth-child(7)::before{background:linear-gradient(90deg,var(--c-dep),var(--c-cdot))}
.spec:hover{transform:translateY(-6px);box-shadow:0 16px 34px rgba(20,38,31,.13)}
.spec .strip{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:11px;letter-spacing:.14em;text-transform:uppercase;
  padding:12px 20px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line-2);display:flex;justify-content:space-between;
  gap:14px;font-weight:600}
.spec:nth-child(1) .strip{color:var(--c-dep)}
.spec:nth-child(2) .strip{color:var(--c-poly)}
.spec:nth-child(3) .strip{color:var(--c-cdot)}
.spec:nth-child(4) .strip{color:var(--c-water)}
.spec:nth-child(5) .strip{color:var(--c-sep)}
.spec:nth-child(6) .strip{color:var(--c-edu)}
.spec:nth-child(7) .strip{color:var(--c-cdot)}
.spec .strip i{font-style:normal;color:var(--muted)}
.spec .bd{padding:24px 20px 26px;flex:1;display:flex;flex-direction:column}
.spec h3{margin-bottom:12px}
.spec p{font-size:17px;color:var(--body-tx);margin-bottom:18px}
.chain{margin-top:auto;font-family:var(--mono);font-size:11.5px;letter-spacing:.04em;
  color:var(--muted);line-height:2;border-top:1px dashed var(--line);padding-top:14px}
.chain b{color:var(--ink);font-weight:600}

/* journey */
.journey{margin-top:52px;border-top:2px solid var(--ink)}
.leg{display:grid;grid-template-columns:120px 1fr;gap:28px;padding:24px 0;
  border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);align-items:baseline}
.leg time{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:13px;color:var(--c-water);white-space:nowrap;font-weight:600}
.leg h4{font-family:var(--body);font-weight:700;font-size:19px;margin:0 0 4px;letter-spacing:0;line-height:1.3}
.leg p{margin:0;font-size:17px;color:var(--body-tx)}

/* rows */
.rows{border-top:2px solid var(--ink)}
.row{display:grid;grid-template-columns:126px 1fr 200px;gap:24px;padding:18px 0;
  border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);align-items:start}
.row:hover{background:rgba(222,131,6,.05)}
.row .yr{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:13px;color:var(--c-water);letter-spacing:.04em;
  padding-top:2px;font-weight:600}
.row .ttl{font-size:18px;line-height:1.45;color:var(--ink)}
.row .ttl small{display:block;font-family:var(--mono);font-size:12px;letter-spacing:.05em;
  color:var(--muted);margin-top:5px;text-transform:uppercase}
.row .meta{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:12.5px;color:var(--muted);line-height:1.75;text-align:right}
.pill{display:inline-block;font-family:var(--mono);font-size:10px;letter-spacing:.11em;
  text-transform:uppercase;padding:3px 10px;border-radius:100px;font-weight:600}
.pill{background:rgba(20,38,31,.07);color:var(--body-tx)}
.pill.on{background:rgba(7,150,176,.14);color:#046579}
.pill.lead{background:rgba(222,131,6,.18);color:#96560A}

.split{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:40px}
.stack{border-top:2px solid var(--ink)}
.item{padding:16px 0;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line)}
.item h4{font-family:var(--body);font-weight:700;font-size:18px;margin:0 0 4px;letter-spacing:0;line-height:1.35}
.item p{margin:0;font-size:16.5px;color:var(--body-tx)}
.item .when{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:12px;letter-spacing:.05em;color:var(--acc);
  float:right;margin-left:16px;font-weight:600}
.groupname{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:12.5px;letter-spacing:.16em;text-transform:uppercase;
  color:var(--ink);margin:40px 0 10px;padding-bottom:8px;font-weight:600;
  border-bottom:3px solid var(--acc);display:inline-block}

/* tools */
.tool{background:var(--white);border:1px solid var(--line-2);border-radius:12px;padding:28px;
  margin-top:36px;box-shadow:0 10px 30px rgba(20,38,31,.06)}
.toolhead{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:flex-end;gap:20px;flex-wrap:wrap;
  padding-bottom:18px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);margin-bottom:22px}
.toolhead h3{margin:0}
.count{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:12.5px;letter-spacing:.08em;color:var(--acc);font-weight:600}

.controls{display:flex;gap:12px;flex-wrap:wrap;align-items:center;margin-bottom:20px}
input[type=search],select{font-family:var(--body);font-size:16.5px;padding:11px 15px;
  border:1px solid var(--line);background:#fff;color:var(--ink);border-radius:8px;min-width:190px}
input[type=search]{flex:1;min-width:240px}
input[type=search]:focus,select:focus{outline:2px solid var(--acc2);outline-offset:1px;border-color:transparent}
.chips{display:flex;gap:8px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-bottom:22px}
.chip{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:12px;letter-spacing:.08em;text-transform:uppercase;
  padding:8px 14px;border:1.5px solid var(--line);background:#fff;cursor:pointer;
  color:var(--muted);transition:.2s;border-radius:100px;font-weight:600}
.chip:hover{border-color:var(--ink);color:var(--ink)}
.chip .n{opacity:.6;margin-left:6px}
.chip[data-k=all][aria-pressed=true]{background:var(--ink);border-color:var(--ink);color:#fff}
.chip[data-k=dep][aria-pressed=true]{background:var(--c-dep);border-color:var(--c-dep);color:#fff}
.chip[data-k=poly][aria-pressed=true]{background:var(--c-poly);border-color:var(--c-poly);color:#fff}
.chip[data-k=cdot][aria-pressed=true]{background:var(--c-cdot);border-color:var(--c-cdot);color:#fff}
.chip[data-k=water][aria-pressed=true]{background:var(--c-water);border-color:var(--c-water);color:#fff}
.chip[data-k=sep][aria-pressed=true]{background:var(--c-sep);border-color:var(--c-sep);color:#fff}
.chip[data-k=edu][aria-pressed=true]{background:var(--c-edu);border-color:var(--c-edu);color:#fff}

.histo{display:flex;align-items:stretch;gap:3px;height:86px;margin:4px 0 26px;
  border-bottom:2px solid var(--ink)}
.bar{flex:1;background:rgba(20,38,31,.06);position:relative;height:100%;border-radius:3px 3px 0 0;overflow:hidden}
.bar b{position:absolute;inset:0;background:linear-gradient(180deg,var(--acc2),var(--c-dep));transition:.4s}
.bar span{position:absolute;bottom:-19px;left:50%;transform:translateX(-50%) rotate(-90deg);
  font-family:var(--mono);font-size:9px;color:var(--muted);display:none}
.bar:hover b{background:linear-gradient(180deg,var(--c-sep),var(--c-cdot))}
.bar:hover span{display:block}

.pubs{max-height:560px;overflow-y:auto;border-top:1px solid var(--line)}
.pub{padding:15px 4px 15px 0;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);display:grid;
  grid-template-columns:60px 1fr;gap:18px}
.pub .py{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:13px;color:var(--muted)}
.pub h5{font-family:var(--body);font-weight:600;font-size:17px;margin:0 0 4px;
  line-height:1.4;letter-spacing:0;color:var(--ink)}
.pub .jr{font-size:15px;color:var(--muted);font-style:italic}
.pub .tags{margin-top:7px;display:flex;gap:7px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.tag{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:10.5px;letter-spacing:.1em;text-transform:uppercase;
  padding:3px 9px;border-radius:100px;font-weight:600;background:rgba(20,38,31,.06);color:var(--muted)}
.tag.t-dep{background:rgba(91,63,214,.12);color:var(--c-dep)}
.tag.t-poly{background:rgba(18,160,91,.14);color:#0B7A44}
.tag.t-cdot{background:rgba(214,33,140,.12);color:var(--c-cdot)}
.tag.t-water{background:rgba(7,150,176,.14);color:#046579}
.tag.t-sep{background:rgba(222,131,6,.16);color:#96560A}
.tag.t-edu{background:rgba(226,75,54,.13);color:var(--c-edu)}
.tag.q1{background:var(--ink);color:#fff}
.tag.corr{background:transparent;border:1px solid var(--line);color:var(--body-tx)}
.empty{padding:44px 0;text-align:center;color:var(--muted);font-size:15px}

/* matchmaker */
.mm-opts{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(230px,1fr));gap:12px}
.mm-opt{text-align:left;padding:22px;border:1.5px solid var(--line);background:#fff;border-radius:10px;
  color:var(--ink);cursor:pointer;transition:.25s;font-size:18px;line-height:1.35}
.mm-opt:hover{border-color:var(--acc2);box-shadow:0 10px 24px rgba(7,150,176,.16);transform:translateY(-3px)}
.mm-opt em{display:block;font-family:var(--mono);font-size:10px;letter-spacing:.14em;
  text-transform:uppercase;font-style:normal;margin-bottom:10px;font-weight:700}
.mm-opt:nth-child(1) em{color:var(--c-water)}
.mm-opt:nth-child(2) em{color:var(--c-dep)}
.mm-opt:nth-child(3) em{color:var(--c-poly)}
.mm-opt:nth-child(4) em{color:var(--c-sep)}
.mm-opt:nth-child(5) em{color:var(--c-edu)}
.mm-opt:nth-child(6) em{color:var(--c-cdot)}
.mm-res{display:none}
.mm-res.on{display:block;animation:rise .45s ease both}
@keyframes rise{from{opacity:0;transform:translateY(10px)}to{opacity:1;transform:none}}
.mm-res h4{font-family:var(--disp);font-size:30px;font-weight:400;margin:0 0 12px}
.mm-res .evid{border-top:1px dashed var(--line);margin-top:20px;padding-top:16px}
.mm-res .evid li{font-size:16.5px;color:var(--body-tx);margin-bottom:9px;line-height:1.5}
.mm-res ul{padding-left:18px;margin:0}
.mm-cta{display:inline-block;margin-top:22px;background:var(--ink);color:#fff;text-decoration:none;
  padding:12px 20px;border-radius:100px;font-weight:600;font-size:15px}
.mm-cta:hover{background:var(--acc)}
.backbtn{margin-top:24px;margin-left:12px;background:transparent;border:1.5px solid var(--line);
  color:var(--muted);font-family:var(--mono);font-size:11px;letter-spacing:.12em;
  text-transform:uppercase;padding:12px 18px;cursor:pointer;border-radius:100px;font-weight:600}
.backbtn:hover{border-color:var(--ink);color:var(--ink)}

/* quiz */
.q-card{max-width:760px}
.q-q{font-family:var(--disp);font-size:27px;line-height:1.25;margin:0 0 20px;color:var(--ink)}
.q-opts{display:grid;gap:10px}
.q-opt{text-align:left;padding:16px 20px;border:1.5px solid var(--line);background:#fff;
  cursor:pointer;font-size:17px;transition:.2s;border-radius:9px;color:var(--ink)}
.q-opt:hover{border-color:var(--c-edu)}
.q-opt.right{border-color:var(--c-poly);background:rgba(18,160,91,.12)}
.q-opt.wrong{border-color:var(--c-edu);background:rgba(226,75,54,.1)}
.q-fb{margin-top:16px;font-size:16.5px;color:var(--body-tx);min-height:24px}
.q-bar{display:flex;gap:5px;margin-bottom:22px}
.q-bar i{height:4px;flex:1;background:rgba(20,38,31,.1);border-radius:3px}
.q-bar i.done{background:var(--c-poly)}
.q-bar i.now{background:var(--c-edu)}

/* contact */
.links{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(210px,1fr));gap:12px;margin-top:40px}
.links a{background:#fff;border:1px solid var(--line-2);border-radius:10px;padding:22px 20px;
  text-decoration:none;transition:.25s;display:block;box-shadow:0 1px 2px rgba(20,38,31,.05)}
.links a:hover{transform:translateY(-4px);box-shadow:0 14px 28px rgba(20,38,31,.12)}
.links a em{font-style:normal;font-family:var(--mono);font-size:10px;letter-spacing:.14em;
  text-transform:uppercase;display:block;margin-bottom:8px;font-weight:700}
.links a:nth-child(1) em{color:var(--c-sep)}
.links a:nth-child(2) em{color:var(--c-poly)}
.links a:nth-child(3) em{color:var(--c-dep)}
.links a:nth-child(4) em{color:var(--c-water)}
.links a:nth-child(5) em{color:var(--c-cdot)}
.links a:nth-child(6) em{color:var(--c-edu)}
.links a b{font-weight:600;font-size:17px;color:var(--ink);word-break:break-word}

footer{background:var(--ink);color:rgba(255,255,255,.65);padding:32px 0 44px;
  font-family:var(--mono);font-size:12px;letter-spacing:.06em}
footer .wrap{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:20px;flex-wrap:wrap}

.reveal{opacity:0;transform:translateY(18px)}
.reveal.seen{opacity:1;transform:none;
  transition:opacity .7s ease,transform .7s cubic-bezier(.2,.7,.3,1)}

/* ---- research ID chips ---- */
.ids{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:10px;margin:30px 0 0}
.id{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:9px;text-decoration:none;background:#fff;
  border:1.5px solid var(--line);border-radius:100px;padding:9px 16px 9px 11px;
  font-family:var(--mono);font-size:12px;letter-spacing:.06em;font-weight:600;color:var(--ink);
  transition:.22s;box-shadow:0 1px 2px rgba(20,38,31,.05)}
.id:hover{transform:translateY(-3px);box-shadow:0 10px 22px rgba(20,38,31,.14)}
.id .dot{width:22px;height:22px;border-radius:50%;display:grid;place-items:center;
  color:#fff;font-size:11px;font-weight:700;flex:none}
.id small{color:var(--muted);font-weight:500;letter-spacing:0}
.id-orcid .dot{background:#A6CE39}
.id-scopus .dot{background:#E9711C}
.id-scholar .dot{background:#4285F4}
.id-rg .dot{background:#00CCBB}
.id-yt .dot{background:#FF0033}
.id-li .dot{background:#0A66C2}

/* ---- specimen artwork ---- */
.art{position:relative;line-height:0;background:#fff}
.art svg{width:100%;height:150px;display:block}

/* ---- media / news ---- */
.news{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(320px,1fr));gap:20px;margin-top:44px}
.newscard{background:#fff;border:1px solid var(--line-2);border-radius:12px;overflow:hidden;
  text-decoration:none;display:flex;flex-direction:column;transition:.28s;
  box-shadow:0 2px 6px rgba(20,38,31,.06)}
.newscard:hover{transform:translateY(-6px);box-shadow:0 18px 38px rgba(20,38,31,.14)}
.newscard .banner{height:120px;display:grid;place-items:center;padding:0 22px;text-align:center;
  font-family:var(--disp);font-size:23px;color:#fff;line-height:1.15}
.newscard .nb{padding:22px 22px 26px}
.newscard .src{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:11px;letter-spacing:.14em;text-transform:uppercase;
  color:var(--acc);font-weight:700;margin-bottom:10px;display:block}
.newscard h4{font-family:var(--disp);font-size:22px;font-weight:400;margin:0 0 10px;line-height:1.2}
.newscard p{font-size:16.5px;color:var(--body-tx);margin:0}
.newscard .go{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:12px;letter-spacing:.08em;color:var(--acc2);
  font-weight:700;margin-top:16px;display:block}

/* ---- compact social / coverage links ---- */
.socialrow{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(290px,1fr));gap:16px;margin-top:22px}
.soc{display:flex;gap:16px;align-items:flex-start;background:#fff;border:1px solid var(--line-2);
  border-radius:12px;padding:20px 22px;text-decoration:none;transition:.26s;
  box-shadow:0 2px 6px rgba(20,38,31,.05)}
.soc:hover{transform:translateY(-5px);box-shadow:0 16px 32px rgba(20,38,31,.13)}
.soc .badge{width:42px;height:42px;border-radius:11px;flex:none;display:grid;place-items:center;
  color:#fff;font-family:var(--mono);font-size:19px;font-weight:700}
.soc-fb .badge{background:#1877F2}
.soc-li .badge{background:#0A66C2}
.soc-ig .badge{background:linear-gradient(135deg,#F58529,#DD2A7B,#8134AF)}
.soc .st{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:11px;letter-spacing:.13em;text-transform:uppercase;
  color:var(--muted);font-weight:700;display:block;margin-bottom:6px}
.soc h4{font-family:var(--body);font-weight:700;font-size:17.5px;margin:0 0 6px;line-height:1.3;letter-spacing:0}
.soc p{margin:0;font-size:15.5px;color:var(--body-tx);line-height:1.5}
.soc .go2{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:11.5px;letter-spacing:.08em;color:var(--acc2);
  font-weight:700;margin-top:12px;display:block}

/* ---- medal wall ---- */
.medals{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(230px,1fr));gap:16px;margin-top:40px}
.medal{border-radius:12px;padding:24px 22px;color:#fff;position:relative;overflow:hidden}
.medal.g{background:linear-gradient(140deg,#E0A32B,#B8781A)}
.medal.s{background:linear-gradient(140deg,#9AA7AE,#6E7C85)}
.medal.b{background:linear-gradient(140deg,#C8804F,#96562F)}
.medal .n{font-family:var(--disp);font-size:56px;line-height:1;display:block;color:#fff}
.medal .l{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:12px;letter-spacing:.14em;text-transform:uppercase;
  margin-top:8px;display:block;opacity:.92;font-weight:600}
.medal ul{margin:16px 0 0;padding-left:16px;font-size:14.5px;line-height:1.55;opacity:.95}
.medal li{margin-bottom:5px}
.medal::after{content:"";position:absolute;width:150px;height:150px;border-radius:50%;
  background:rgba(255,255,255,.12);right:-52px;top:-52px}

/* ---- video / channel ---- */
.channel{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.05fr .95fr;gap:36px;align-items:start;margin-top:32px}
.playwrap{background:linear-gradient(140deg,#FF0033,#B3001F);border-radius:16px;padding:44px 32px;
  text-align:center;color:#fff;text-decoration:none;display:block;transition:.28s}
.playwrap:hover{transform:translateY(-5px);box-shadow:0 20px 44px rgba(255,0,51,.3)}
.playwrap .tri{width:74px;height:74px;border-radius:50%;background:#fff;display:grid;place-items:center;
  margin:0 auto 20px}
.playwrap .tri span{border-left:22px solid #FF0033;border-top:14px solid transparent;
  border-bottom:14px solid transparent;margin-left:6px}
.playwrap b{display:block;font-family:var(--disp);font-size:26px;font-weight:400;margin-bottom:8px}
.playwrap i{font-style:normal;font-family:var(--mono);font-size:12px;letter-spacing:.1em;opacity:.9}
.topics{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr);gap:10px;margin-top:22px}
.topic{background:#fff;border:1px solid var(--line-2);border-radius:9px;padding:14px 16px;
  font-size:16px;color:var(--ink);display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px}
.topic em{width:9px;height:9px;border-radius:50%;flex:none}

/* ---- gallery ---- */
.gallery{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(250px,1fr));gap:16px;margin-top:40px}
figure.g-item{margin:0;border-radius:12px;overflow:hidden;background:#fff;
  border:1px solid var(--line-2);box-shadow:0 2px 6px rgba(20,38,31,.06);transition:.28s}
figure.g-item:hover{transform:translateY(-5px);box-shadow:0 16px 34px rgba(20,38,31,.13)}
.g-frame{height:210px;display:grid;place-items:center;position:relative;text-align:center;padding:20px}
.g-frame img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;position:absolute;inset:0}
.g-frame .ph{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:11px;letter-spacing:.12em;text-transform:uppercase;
  color:rgba(255,255,255,.95);font-weight:700;line-height:1.9;z-index:1}
.g-frame .ph b{display:block;font-family:var(--disp);font-size:21px;letter-spacing:0;
  text-transform:none;font-weight:400;margin-bottom:8px;text-shadow:0 1px 6px rgba(0,0,0,.22)}
figure.g-item figcaption{padding:16px 18px 20px;font-size:16px;color:var(--body-tx)}
figure.g-item figcaption b{display:block;color:var(--ink);font-weight:700;margin-bottom:3px}

/* ---- gallery images + lightbox ---- */
figure.g-item{cursor:zoom-in}
.g-frame img{z-index:2}
.gallery+.gallery{margin-top:0}
.g-item.poster .g-frame{height:210px}
.g-item.poster .g-frame img{object-fit:contain;background:#fff}
.lbox{position:fixed;inset:0;background:rgba(10,20,16,.94);z-index:200;display:none;
  align-items:center;justify-content:center;padding:36px;flex-direction:column;gap:18px}
.lbox.on{display:flex}
.lbox img{max-width:min(1100px,92vw);max-height:78vh;object-fit:contain;border-radius:10px;
  box-shadow:0 30px 70px rgba(0,0,0,.5)}
.lbox p{color:#fff;font-size:17px;max-width:70ch;text-align:center;margin:0}
.lbox button{position:absolute;top:22px;right:26px;background:transparent;border:1.5px solid rgba(255,255,255,.4);
  color:#fff;border-radius:100px;padding:10px 18px;font-family:var(--mono);font-size:12px;
  letter-spacing:.12em;cursor:pointer}
.lbox button:hover{border-color:#fff}

/* ---- portrait aside ---- */
.aside2{display:grid;grid-template-columns:.8fr 1.2fr;gap:40px;align-items:center;margin-top:44px}
.aside2 .ph{border-radius:14px;overflow:hidden;box-shadow:0 18px 40px rgba(20,38,31,.16)}
.pull{font-family:var(--disp);font-size:clamp(24px,2.8vw,32px);line-height:1.28;color:var(--ink);
  margin:0 0 18px;font-weight:400}

@media (max-width:900px){
  .channel,.aside2{grid-template-columns:1fr;gap:26px}
  .topics{grid-template-columns:1fr}
}

@media (max-width:900px){

  .row{grid-template-columns:1fr;gap:6px}

  .leg{grid-template-columns:1fr;gap:4px}
  section{padding:70px 0}

}

  .metrics{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr)}

}
/* ---- vibrant colour bands ---- */
.cband{border-radius:18px;padding:38px 36px 34px;color:#fff;margin-top:52px;position:relative;
  overflow:hidden;display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(170px,1fr));
  gap:28px 30px;align-items:start;box-shadow:0 20px 46px rgba(20,38,31,.16);z-index:2}
.cband::after{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;pointer-events:none;background:
  radial-gradient(circle at 90% -20%,rgba(255,255,255,.38),transparent 58%),
  radial-gradient(circle at 4% 125%,rgba(255,255,255,.24),transparent 52%)}
.cband>*{position:relative;z-index:2}
.cband .cb b{display:block;font-family:var(--disp);font-size:51.8px;line-height:.92;font-weight:400}
.cband .cb span{display:block;font-family:var(--mono);font-size:11.2px;letter-spacing:.14em;
  text-transform:uppercase;margin-top:13px;opacity:.92;line-height:1.55}
.cband .cb-say{grid-column:1/-1;font-family:var(--disp);font-size:27.7px;line-height:1.26;
  margin:0;max-width:34ch}
.cband .cb-kicker{grid-column:1/-1;font-family:var(--mono);font-size:11.2px;letter-spacing:.16em;
  text-transform:uppercase;margin:0;opacity:.86}
.cband.v1{background:linear-gradient(118deg,#5B3FD6,#D6218C 54%,#DE8306)}
.cband.v2{background:linear-gradient(118deg,#0796B0,#5B3FD6 55%,#D6218C)}
.cband.v3{background:linear-gradient(118deg,#E24B36,#D6218C 48%,#5B3FD6)}
.cband.v4{background:linear-gradient(118deg,#12A05B,#0796B0 52%,#5B3FD6)}
@media (max-width:640px){
  .cband{padding:28px 24px 26px;gap:20px}

  .cband .cb-say{font-size:21.4px}
}

/* hero metrics as colour blocks */
.metric{overflow:hidden}
.metric::after{content:"";position:absolute;left:0;right:0;top:0;height:5px}
.metric:nth-child(1){background:linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(91,63,214,.10),transparent 72%)}
.metric:nth-child(2){background:linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(214,33,140,.10),transparent 72%)}

.metric:nth-child(5){background:linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(222,131,6,.10),transparent 72%)}
.metric:nth-child(6){background:linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(226,75,54,.10),transparent 72%)}
.metric:nth-child(1)::after{background:var(--c-dep)}
.metric:nth-child(2)::after{background:var(--c-cdot)}
.metric:nth-child(3)::after{background:var(--c-water)}
.metric:nth-child(4)::after{background:var(--c-poly)}
.metric:nth-child(5)::after{background:var(--c-sep)}
.metric:nth-child(6)::after{background:var(--c-edu)}

.handoff{margin-top:64px;padding-top:34px;border-top:2px solid var(--ink)}

/* ---- left spine navigation + tab panels ---- */
.spine{position:sticky;top:0;z-index:60;background:rgba(255,255,255,.97);
  backdrop-filter:blur(10px);border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);
  display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;align-items:flex-start;gap:8px;padding:15px 22px}
.spinemark{font-family:var(--disp);font-size:19px;font-weight:400;line-height:1.2;
  letter-spacing:-.015em;color:var(--ink);background:none;border:0;text-align:left;
  white-space:nowrap;flex:none;cursor:pointer;padding:0 18px 0 0;margin:6px 14px 6px 0;
  border-right:1px solid var(--line-2)}
.spinemark b{font-weight:400;
  background:linear-gradient(92deg,var(--c-sep),var(--c-cdot));
  -webkit-background-clip:text;background-clip:text;color:transparent}
.spinemark em{display:none}
.spinelinks{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:8px;flex:1 1 320px;min-width:0}
.spinelinks button{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:9px;flex:0 0 auto;
  font-family:var(--mono);font-size:13.5px;letter-spacing:.02em;text-transform:uppercase;
  font-weight:600;color:var(--ink);border:0;cursor:pointer;border-radius:11px;
  background:#E4F0F7;padding:9px 13px;transition:.2s cubic-bezier(.2,.7,.3,1);
  white-space:nowrap;line-height:1.2}
.spinelinks button i{width:9px;height:9px;border-radius:50%;flex:none;transition:.2s;
  background:var(--tc,var(--acc));box-shadow:0 0 0 3px rgba(255,255,255,.75)}
.spinelinks button:hover{background:#D3E7F2}
.spinelinks button:hover i{transform:scale(1.15)}
.spinelinks button[aria-current="true"]{background:#BCDCEE;
  box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 2px var(--tc,var(--ink)),0 4px 12px rgba(20,38,31,.10)}
.spinelinks button[aria-current="true"] i{box-shadow:0 0 0 4px rgba(255,255,255,.95)}
.spinelinks button:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--acc2);outline-offset:-2px}

main#stage{display:flex;flex-direction:column}
.panel{display:none}
.panel.on{display:block;animation:panelIn .42s cubic-bezier(.2,.7,.3,1) both}
@keyframes panelIn{from{opacity:0;transform:translateY(14px)}to{opacity:1;transform:none}}
main#stage>footer{margin-top:auto}

@media (max-width:700px){
  .spine{padding:12px 14px;gap:6px}
  .spinemark{display:none}
  .spinelinks{gap:6px}
  .spinelinks button{font-size:12px;padding:8px 11px;gap:7px}
  .spinelinks button i{width:8px;height:8px}
}


@media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){
  *{animation:none!important;transition:none!important}
  .reveal{opacity:1;transform:none}
  html{scroll-behavior:auto}
}

<section class="dark panel" id="spotlight">
  <div class="wrap">
    <p class="eyebrow reveal">The thesis</p>
    <h2 class="reveal" style="max-width:19ch">Seven lines of work. One recurring question.</h2>
    <p class="lede reveal">Every project below starts in the same place: a Malaysian bio-resource that is abundant, under-used, or thrown away. The engineering question is always what separates, what binds, and what can be sensed &mdash; and the answer has become membranes, sensors, resins, coatings, insulating fluids and treated water.</p>

    <div class="specimens">
      <article class="spec reveal">
        <div class="strip"><span>Specimen 01</span><i>2002 &rarr; now</i></div>
        <div class="art"><svg viewBox="0 0 400 150" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" role="img" aria-label="Dielectrophoretic separation between electrode arrays">
<defs><linearGradient id="dg" x1="0" x2="1"><stop offset="0" stop-color="#5B3FD6" stop-opacity=".1"/><stop offset="1" stop-color="#0796B0" stop-opacity=".1"/></linearGradient></defs>
<rect width="400" height="150" fill="url(#dg)"/>
<g stroke="#5B3FD6" stroke-width="7" stroke-linecap="round" opacity=".85">
<line x1="46" y1="26" x2="46" y2="124"/><line x1="86" y1="26" x2="86" y2="124"/>
<line x1="314" y1="26" x2="314" y2="124"/><line x1="354" y1="26" x2="354" y2="124"/></g>
<g stroke="#5B3FD6" stroke-width="1.5" fill="none" opacity=".4">
<path d="M96 40 C170 20 230 20 304 40"/><path d="M96 62 C170 48 230 48 304 62"/>
<path d="M96 88 C170 102 230 102 304 88"/><path d="M96 110 C170 130 230 130 304 110"/></g>
<g><circle cx="150" cy="46" r="8" fill="#D6218C"/><circle cx="196" cy="38" r="6" fill="#D6218C"/><circle cx="244" cy="47" r="7" fill="#D6218C"/>
<circle cx="160" cy="104" r="9" fill="#0796B0"/><circle cx="212" cy="112" r="7" fill="#0796B0"/><circle cx="258" cy="103" r="8" fill="#0796B0"/></g>
<circle cx="200" cy="75" r="4" fill="#5B3FD6"/></svg></div><div class="bd">
          <h3>Electrokinetics &amp; lab-on-chip biosensors</h3>
          <p>Dielectrophoretic separation of live cells at scale &mdash; from high-gradient electric fields and textile wire-cloth electrodes to pulsed DEP-FFF chips coupled with free-space fibre-optic detection for <em>E.&nbsp;coli</em>, <em>Aeromonas hydrophila</em> and yeast.</p>
          <p class="chain">FEEDSTOCK <b>Textile wire cloth, microelectrodes</b><br>PROCESS <b>DEP-FFF + optical fibre detection</b><br>OUTPUT <b>Portable pathogen screening</b></p>
        </div>
      </article>

      <article class="spec reveal">
        <div class="strip"><span>Specimen 02</span><i>2009 &rarr; now</i></div>
        <div class="art"><svg viewBox="0 0 400 150" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" role="img" aria-label="Polymer chain crosslinking from vegetable oil">
<rect width="400" height="150" fill="#12A05B" fill-opacity=".08"/>
<path d="M10 100 C60 40 110 40 160 100 S260 160 310 100 360 40 400 78" fill="none" stroke="#12A05B" stroke-width="6" stroke-linecap="round"/>
<path d="M10 62 C60 122 110 122 160 62 S260 2 310 62 360 122 400 40" fill="none" stroke="#12A05B" stroke-width="3" stroke-opacity=".45" stroke-linecap="round"/>
<g fill="#12A05B"><circle cx="85" cy="66" r="9"/><circle cx="160" cy="100" r="11"/><circle cx="235" cy="132" r="9"/><circle cx="310" cy="100" r="11"/></g>
<g fill="#DE8306"><circle cx="48" cy="34" r="7"/><circle cx="122" cy="34" r="7"/><circle cx="272" cy="34" r="7"/><circle cx="356" cy="52" r="7"/></g>
<g stroke="#DE8306" stroke-width="2" stroke-opacity=".6"><line x1="48" y1="34" x2="85" y2="66"/><line x1="122" y1="34" x2="85" y2="66"/><line x1="272" y1="34" x2="310" y2="100"/></g></svg></div><div class="bd">
          <h3>Bio-based polymers from jatropha &amp; palm oil</h3>
          <p>A full chain from seed to certified panel: solid-liquid extraction, epoxidation of methyl esters, bioresin for carbon-fibre aerospace laminates, jatropha polyurethane filtration membranes, bamboo bio-polyurethane coatings, and now vitrimers and wound dressing.</p>
          <p class="chain">FEEDSTOCK <b>Jatropha curcas, palm methyl ester</b><br>PROCESS <b>Epoxidation, polyol synthesis, casting</b><br>OUTPUT <b>Membranes, resins, coatings, dressings</b></p>
        </div>
      </article>

      <article class="spec reveal">

          <h3>Carbon dots from agricultural waste</h3>
          <p>Empty fruit bunch and tapioca converted into nitrogen-doped fluorescent carbon dots, then optimised by RSM and neural networks for selective detection and capture of Cu&sup2;⁺, Cd&sup2;⁺, Pb&sup2;⁺, Hg&sup2;⁺ and Fe&sup3;⁺ &mdash; and printed into films, security inks and screen-printed electrodes.</p>
          <p class="chain">FEEDSTOCK <b>Oil palm EFB, tapioca</b><br>PROCESS <b>Hydrothermal synthesis, RSM/ANN</b><br>OUTPUT <b>Heavy-metal sensors &amp; sorbents</b></p>

          <h3>Green coagulants &amp; water treatment</h3>
          <p>Identifying the active coagulant protein in <em>Jatropha curcas</em> seed and turning it into a spray-dried powder &mdash; alongside rambutan seed, dragon fruit foliage, mushroom chitosan and moringa. Extended to hypersaline oilfield produced water and palm oil mill effluent.</p>
          <p class="chain">FEEDSTOCK <b>Seed presscake, foliage, chitosan</b><br>PROCESS <b>Extraction, spray drying, MBR</b><br>OUTPUT <b>Patented coagulant, treated effluent</b></p>
        </div>
      </article>

      <article class="spec reveal">
        <div class="strip"><span>Specimen 05</span><i>2023 &rarr; now</i></div>

<g fill="#DE8306" opacity=".3"><circle cx="56" cy="60" r="20"/></g></svg></div><div class="bd">
          <h3>Frontier: fluids, sugars and soft tissue</h3>
          <p>Three live fronts &mdash; a high-oleic palm methyl ester bio-insulating oil for transformers, recovery of the rare low-glycaemic sugar trehalulose from stingless bee honey by ion-exchange adsorption, and polyurethane wound dressing with Kyushu Institute of Technology.</p>
          <p class="chain">FEEDSTOCK <b>HOPME, stingless bee honey</b><br>PROCESS <b>Transesterification, ion exchange</b><br>OUTPUT <b>Dielectric fluid, rare sugar, dressing</b></p>
        </div>
      </article>

          <h3>Separation &amp; extraction technology</h3>
          <p>Subcritical water and pressurised hot water extraction of essential oils from <em>Aquilaria malaccensis</em> and <em>Citrus hystrix</em>, ohmic-heated hydro-distillation of citronella, and integrated fermentation&ndash;pervaporation modelling for bioethanol recovery.</p>
          <p class="chain">FEEDSTOCK <b>Gaharu, kaffir lime, molasses</b><br>PROCESS <b>Subcritical water, pervaporation</b><br>OUTPUT <b>Essential oils, bioethanol, models</b></p>
        </div>
      </article>

<line x1="232" y1="126" x2="376" y2="126" stroke="#14261F" stroke-width="1.5" opacity=".35"/></svg></div><div class="bd">
          <h3>Sensors &amp; detection platforms</h3>
          <p>Turning the same separation physics into a readout. Fibre-optic microchannel sensors for <em>Aeromonas hydrophila</em> and <em>E.&nbsp;coli</em>, carbon-dot fluorescent probes that report Fe<sup>3+</sup>, Cu<sup>2+</sup> and Hg(II) in water, screen-printed electrodes modified with starch carbon dots for simultaneous cadmium, lead and copper, and dielectric screening at 0.5&ndash;50&nbsp;GHz that tells pork from chicken and beef for rapid <b>halal</b> authentication.</p>
          <p class="chain">FEEDSTOCK <b>Waste-derived carbon dots, optical fibre</b><br>PROCESS <b>Fluorescence quenching, voltammetry, dielectric response</b><br>OUTPUT <b>Field-deployable water, pathogen &amp; halal food sensors</b></p>
        </div>

<section class="panel" id="journey">
  <div class="wrap">
    <p class="eyebrow reveal">The line</p>
    <h2 class="reveal">From a drawing office in Pahang to a professorial chair.</h2>
    <div class="journey reveal">
      <div class="leg"><time>1997</time><div><h4>BEng (Hons) Chemical Engineering</h4><p>Loughborough University, United Kingdom.</p></div></div>
      <div class="leg"><time>1998&ndash;1999</time><div><h4>Process Engineer, Elektrisola (M) Sdn Bhd</h4><p>Drawing department, Janda Baik, Pahang. Vice Chairman of the Safety Committee and internal auditor &mdash; the industrial grounding behind everything since.</p></div></div>
      <div class="leg"><time>1999&ndash;2005</time><div><h4>Tutor, Universiti Putra Malaysia</h4><p>Teaching while completing postgraduate study in the UK.</p></div></div>
      <div class="leg"><time>2001</time><div><h4>MSc Biotechnology, UMIST</h4><p>Manchester, United Kingdom.</p></div></div>
      <div class="leg"><time>2006</time><div><h4>PhD, University of Manchester</h4><p><em>Large Scale Dielectrophoretic Separation of Cells</em>, with Prof. Gerard Markx &mdash; the origin of the electrokinetics and biosensor line.</p></div></div>
      <div class="leg"><time>2006&ndash;</time><div><h4>Lecturer &rarr; Senior Lecturer &rarr; Associate Professor, UPM</h4><p>Building the biochemical engineering laboratory and research section from the ground up.</p></div></div>
      <div class="leg"><time>2014&ndash;2016</time><div><h4>Visiting scholar abroad</h4><p>Fatih Universitesi, Istanbul (Sept 2014&ndash;Jan 2015) and Ho Chi Minh University of Technology under AUNSEED (July 2016).</p></div></div>
      <div class="leg"><time>2020&ndash;</time><div><h4>Professor, Universiti Putra Malaysia</h4><p>Head of Biochemical Engineering Laboratory and Research Group; national curriculum and sustainability taskforces.</p></div></div>
      <div class="leg"><time>2022, 2023</time><div><h4>Top 2% Scientist in the World</h4><p>Stanford University / Elsevier global ranking.</p></div></div>
      <div class="leg"><time>2025&ndash;2026</time><div><h4>SEARCA Professorial Chair</h4><p>Southeast Asian Regional Center for Graduate Study and Research in Agriculture. Finalist, Anugerah Akademik Negara 2025 (Excellent Teacher, Engineering Cluster).</p></div></div>
    </div>

    <div class="cband v2 reveal">
      <p class="cb-kicker">1997 &rarr; now</p>
      <div class="cb"><b>28</b><span>Years from a drawing office in Pahang</span></div>
      <div class="cb"><b>4</b><span>Countries studied, taught or hosted in</span></div>
      <div class="cb"><b>1</b><span>Question that never changed</span></div>
    </div>
  </div>
</section>

<section class="panel" id="awards">
  <div class="wrap">
    <p class="eyebrow reveal">Recognition</p>
    <h2 class="reveal">Twenty-five medals, research and teaching</h2>
    <p class="lede reveal">Awarded at university, national and international exhibitions &mdash; PRPI, MTE, PECIPTA, PICTL and the national innovation carnival &mdash; across both the research and the teaching portfolios.</p>
    <div class="medals">
      <div class="medal g reveal"><span class="n">10</span><span class="l">Gold medals</span>
        <ul><li>Large-scale dielectrophoretic separation using textile wire cloth electrodes</li>
            <li>Double Gold &mdash; enhanced jatropha biomatrix for aerospace panel structures</li>
            <li>Junior STEM Chef teaching module for Orang Asli pupils</li>
            <li>3-in-1 P&amp;ID Maze, Hens Hunt, and real-time competency assessment</li></ul></div>
      <div class="medal s reveal"><span class="n">11</span><span class="l">Silver medals</span>
        <ul><li>Jatropha curcas as biocoagulant for wastewater treatment</li>
            <li>Ultrasound-assisted solid&ndash;liquid extraction of jatropha oil</li>
            <li>Biobased membrane from jatropha oil for filtration</li>
            <li>M2V e-coaching tool for biochemical engineering laboratories</li></ul></div>
      <div class="medal b reveal"><span class="n">4</span><span class="l">Bronze medals</span>
        <ul><li>Isolation and purification of trehalulose from stingless bee honey</li>
            <li>Optimisation and modelling of spray drying of trehalulose extract</li>
            <li>STEM-based activities as alternative teamwork assessment</li></ul></div>
    </div>

    <div class="cband v1 reveal">
      <p class="cb-kicker">What the medals are really for</p>
      <p class="cb-say">Every one of these began as a problem someone actually had &mdash; a mill effluent, a laboratory that could not travel, a class that was not learning.</p>
    </div>
  </div>
</section>

    <p class="lede reveal">29 funded projects since 2006 &mdash; national competitive grants (FRGS, ERGS, PRGS, eScience Fund, MRUN), university grants (Geran Putra, RUGS, GP-IPS, matching), and direct industry funding. Approximately <strong>RM 1.8 million as project leader</strong> and <strong>RM 3.9 million in total</strong> across leader and member roles.</p>

    <div class="rows reveal">
      <div class="row"><div class="yr">2024&ndash;2026</div>

        <div class="meta"><span class="pill lead">Project leader</span><br>Geran Putra, UPM<br>RM 20,000</div></div>
      <div class="row"><div class="yr">2023&ndash;2025</div>
        <div class="ttl">Parametric Studies and Mathematical Modelling of Oleoresin Isolation from <em>Syzygium aromaticum</em> via Subcritical Water Extraction<small>FRGS/1/2023/TK05/UNIMAP/02/10</small></div>

<section class="panel" id="teaching">
  <div class="wrap">
    <p class="eyebrow reveal">Portfolio 05</p>
    <h2 class="reveal">Teaching, video &amp; educational innovation</h2>
    <p class="lede reveal">A second full portfolio, not a footnote. Twenty years of undergraduate teaching in heat transfer, unit operations, physical separation, engineering mathematics and computer-aided drawing &mdash; a sustained programme of designing, testing and publishing new ways to assess engineering students, and an open YouTube channel that puts the same material in front of anyone who needs it.</p>

    <div class="split" style="margin-top:44px">
      <div>
        <p class="groupname" style="margin-top:0">Recognition</p>
        <div class="stack reveal">
          <div class="item"><span class="when">2025</span><h4>Finalist, Anugerah Akademik Negara (AAN15)</h4><p>Excellent Teacher category, Engineering Cluster &mdash; Ministry of Higher Education.</p></div>
          <div class="item"><span class="when">2022</span><h4>Vice Chancellor Fellowship Award</h4><p>Winner, Excellent Teacher, Engineering Cluster, UPM.</p></div>
          <div class="item"><span class="when">2020, 2023</span><h4>Four Gold Medals, PutraInnoCreative Carnival (PICTL)</h4><p>3-in-1 P&amp;ID Maze; real-time on-site competency assessment for engineering drawing; Hens Hunt challenge-based learning; experiment-based assessment via collaborative pairing.</p></div>
          <div class="item"><span class="when">2019</span><h4>Gold Medal, Junior STEM Chef</h4><p>MTE 2019 Teaching Award and Pertandingan Rekacipta Inovasi Nasional &mdash; a STEM module for Orang Asli schoolchildren.</p></div>
          <div class="item"><span class="when">2007&ndash;2022</span><h4>Excellent Teaching Award, UPM</h4><p>Awarded consistently across sixteen years, alongside four Excellent Service Awards.</p></div>
        </div>
      </div>
      <div>
        <p class="groupname" style="margin-top:0">Current practice</p>
        <div class="stack reveal">
          <div class="item"><h4>Learning by brewing</h4><p>A Kolb-aligned, constructivist, learning-oriented assessment in chemical engineering &mdash; published in <em>Education for Chemical Engineers</em> (2026).</p></div>
          <div class="item"><h4>Social-media microlearning</h4><p>Animated explainer videos on distillation, leaching, spray drying, crystallization and gas absorption, published to open platforms and analysed for reach and engagement.</p></div>
          <div class="item"><h4>Education for Sustainable Development</h4><p>Designing how UPM teaches and assesses the eight UNESCO ESD competencies, including rubric architecture under a dedicated programme learning outcome.</p></div>
          <div class="item"><h4>Curriculum policy</h4><p>MQF 2024 and EAC 2024 curriculum revision taskforces &mdash; translating national standards into workable course design.</p></div>
          <div class="item"><h4>Virtual and video laboratory teaching</h4><p>M2V e-coaching tool and copyrighted laboratory videos for sterilization and bioreactor operation.</p></div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>


    <div class="handoff reveal" style="margin-top:52px">
      <p class="eyebrow" style="margin-top:0">Open education</p>
      <h3>Chemical engineering, explained on video</h3>
    </div>
<p class="lede reveal" style="margin-top:10px">Animated explainers on separation processes and unit operations, made for students who need the concept before the derivation. Free to watch, free to use in class.</p>

    <div class="channel">
      <a class="playwrap reveal" href="https://www.youtube.com/@zurinazainalabidin3345" target="_blank" rel="noopener">
        <div class="tri"><span></span></div>
        <b>Zurina Binti Zainal Abidin / ENG</b>
        <i>YOUTUBE CHANNEL &mdash; WATCH NOW</i>
      </a>
      <div class="reveal">
        <h3>What the channel covers</h3>
        <p style="margin-top:12px">Each video takes one unit operation and builds it from the physical idea up &mdash; what is actually moving, why it separates, and where the design limit sits. The same material runs as short-form microlearning on social platforms, and the engagement data feeds back into how the Separation Processes course is taught.</p>
        <div class="topics">
          <div class="topic"><em style="background:#DE8306"></em>Distillation</div>
          <div class="topic"><em style="background:#0796B0"></em>Liquid&ndash;liquid extraction</div>
          <div class="topic"><em style="background:#12A05B"></em>Leaching</div>
          <div class="topic"><em style="background:#D6218C"></em>Spray drying</div>
          <div class="topic"><em style="background:#5B3FD6"></em>Gas absorption</div>
          <div class="topic"><em style="background:#E24B36"></em>Filtration &amp; crystallization</div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>

    <div class="tool reveal q-card" id="quiztool" style="margin-top:52px">
      <div class="toolhead"><h3>Separation processes in sixty seconds</h3><span class="count" id="qscore">Question 1 of 6</span></div>
      <div class="q-bar" id="qbar"></div>
      <p class="q-q" id="qq"></p>
      <div class="q-opts" id="qopts"></div>
      <p class="q-fb" id="qfb"></p>
    </div>
  </div>
</section>

/* ---------------- publications explorer ---------------- */
(function(){
  const list=document.getElementById('publist'), chips=document.getElementById('pubchips'),
        search=document.getElementById('pubsearch'), sort=document.getElementById('pubsort'),
        count=document.getElementById('pubcount'), histo=document.getElementById('histo');
  let active='all';

  const counts={}; PUBS.forEach(p=>counts[p[3]]=(counts[p[3]]||0)+1);
  const order=['all','dep','poly','cdot','water','sep','edu'];
  order.forEach(k=>{
    const b=document.createElement('button');
    b.className='chip'; b.type='button';
    b.setAttribute('aria-pressed', k==='all');
    b.dataset.k=k;
    b.innerHTML=(k==='all'?'All research lines':T[k])+'<span class="n">'+(k==='all'?PUBS.length:counts[k]||0)+'</span>';
    b.addEventListener('click',()=>{active=k;[...chips.children].forEach(c=>c.setAttribute('aria-pressed',c.dataset.k===k));render();});
    chips.appendChild(b);
  });

  function filtered(){
    const q=search.value.trim().toLowerCase();
    let r=PUBS.filter(p=>(active==='all'||p[3]===active) &&
      (!q||(p[1]+' '+p[2]+' '+T[p[3]]).toLowerCase().includes(q)));
    const s=sort.value;
    r=r.slice().sort((a,b)=> s==='az' ? a[1].localeCompare(b[1]) : s==='old' ? a[0]-b[0] : b[0]-a[0]);
    return r;
  }

  function drawHisto(rows){
    const yrs={}; rows.forEach(p=>yrs[p[0]]=(yrs[p[0]]||0)+1);
    const years=[]; for(let y=2005;y<=2026;y++) years.push(y);
    const max=Math.max(1,...Object.values(yrs));
    histo.innerHTML=years.map(y=>{
      const n=yrs[y]||0, h=Math.round((n/max)*100);
      return '<div class="bar" title="'+y+': '+n+'"><b style="top:'+(100-h)+'%"></b><span>'+y+'</span></div>';
    }).join('');
  }

  function render(){
    const rows=filtered();
    count.textContent=rows.length+(rows.length===1?' paper':' papers');
    drawHisto(rows);
    if(!rows.length){list.innerHTML='<p class="empty">No papers match that search. Try a broader term such as “membrane”, “jatropha” or “carbon dots”.</p>';return;}
    list.innerHTML=rows.map(p=>{
      const tags=['<span class="tag t-'+p[3]+'">'+T[p[3]]+'</span>'];
      if(p[4].includes('1')) tags.push('<span class="tag q1">Q1</span>');
      if(p[4].includes('c')) tags.push('<span class="tag corr">Corresponding author</span>');
      return '<article class="pub"><div class="py">'+p[0]+'</div><div><h5>'+p[1]+'</h5>'+
             '<div class="jr">'+p[2]+'</div><div class="tags">'+tags.join('')+'</div></div></article>';
    }).join('');
  }
  search.addEventListener('input',render); sort.addEventListener('change',render);
  render();
  document.querySelectorAll('.metric b')[0].textContent=PUBS.length;
})();

/* ---------------- separation processes quiz ---------------- */
(function(){
  const Q=[
    {q:"A mixture of ethanol and water forms an azeotrope at about 95% ethanol. Which unit operation gets you past that ceiling?",
     a:["Simple distillation at higher reflux","Pervaporation through a selective membrane","Longer residence time in the reboiler","Cooling the condenser further"],c:1,
     f:"Pervaporation. The membrane separates by sorption and diffusion rather than by relative volatility, so the azeotrope simply does not apply — which is why fermentation–pervaporation systems can reach fuel-grade ethanol."},
    {q:"In solid–liquid extraction of oil from jatropha seed, why does ultrasound pretreatment raise the yield?",
     a:["It raises the solvent boiling point","It cavitates and ruptures cell walls, exposing the oil","It converts triglycerides to methyl esters","It reduces the solvent's polarity"],c:1,
     f:"Cavitation collapses microbubbles against the cell wall, rupturing it so solvent reaches oil that diffusion alone would leave behind."},
    {q:"Dielectrophoresis moves cells because of which property of the electric field?",
     a:["Its frequency alone","Its uniformity","Its gradient — the field must be non-uniform","Its polarity reversal rate"],c:2,
     f:"A uniform field exerts no net force on a neutral particle. Dielectrophoretic force scales with the gradient of the field squared, which is exactly why electrode geometry matters so much."},
    {q:"Spray drying converts a liquid biocoagulant extract into powder. What is the main process risk to the product?",
     a:["Thermal degradation of the active protein","Excessive particle charge","Loss of solvent recovery","Increase in bulk density"],c:0,
     f:"The active agent is thermally labile. Inlet temperature, feed rate and carrier choice all trade yield against retained coagulation activity."},
    {q:"Subcritical water extraction works because raising temperature under pressure does what to water?",
     a:["Increases its viscosity","Lowers its dielectric constant so it behaves more like an organic solvent","Raises its surface tension","Converts it to steam inside the vessel"],c:1,
     f:"Between roughly 100 and 374 °C under pressure, water's dielectric constant falls sharply — so it dissolves moderately polar compounds that cold water will not touch, with no organic solvent required."},
    {q:"Why are carbon dots useful as heavy-metal sensors?",
     a:["They change colour permanently on contact","Their fluorescence is quenched selectively by specific metal ions","They precipitate the metal out of solution","They conduct electricity only in the presence of metals"],c:1,
     f:"Selective quenching. Surface functional groups chelate a target ion, which switches off the fluorescence in proportion to concentration — giving a fast, low-cost, visible readout."}
  ];
  const bar=document.getElementById('qbar'), qq=document.getElementById('qq'),
        qo=document.getElementById('qopts'), qf=document.getElementById('qfb'),
        sc=document.getElementById('qscore');
  let i=0, score=0, locked=false;
  function draw(){
    bar.innerHTML=Q.map((_,k)=>'<i class="'+(k<i?'done':k===i?'now':'')+'"></i>').join('');
    if(i>=Q.length){
      sc.textContent='Complete';
      qq.textContent=score===Q.length?'Six out of six. You could teach this course.':
        score>=4?'You scored '+score+' out of 6 — solid separation-process instincts.':
        'You scored '+score+' out of 6. Worth a second run.';
      qo.innerHTML='<button class="q-opt" type="button" id="qagain" style="max-width:220px">Play again</button>';
      qf.textContent='New questions are added as new topics are published.';
      document.getElementById('qagain').addEventListener('click',()=>{i=0;score=0;locked=false;draw();});
      return;
    }
    sc.textContent='Question '+(i+1)+' of '+Q.length;
    qq.textContent=Q[i].q; qf.textContent=''; locked=false;
    qo.innerHTML=Q[i].a.map((a,k)=>'<button class="q-opt" type="button" data-k="'+k+'">'+a+'</button>').join('');
    [...qo.children].forEach(b=>b.addEventListener('click',()=>{
      if(locked) return; locked=true;
      const k=+b.dataset.k, right=Q[i].c;
      qo.children[right].classList.add('right');
      if(k!==right) b.classList.add('wrong'); else score++;
      qf.textContent=Q[i].f;
      setTimeout(()=>{i++;draw();},3200);
    }));
  }
  draw();
})();

/* ---------------- reveal on scroll ---------------- */
(function(){
  document.getElementById('yr').textContent=new Date().getFullYear();
  const lb=document.getElementById('lbox'),lbi=document.getElementById('lbimg'),lbc=document.getElementById('lbcap');
  function closeLb(){lb.classList.remove('on');lbi.src='';}
  document.querySelectorAll('figure.g-item').forEach(f=>f.addEventListener('click',()=>{
    const im=f.querySelector('img'); if(!im) return;
    lbi.src=im.src; lbi.alt=im.alt; lbc.textContent=f.querySelector('figcaption').textContent;
    lb.classList.add('on');
  }));
  document.getElementById('lbclose').addEventListener('click',closeLb);
  lb.addEventListener('click',e=>{if(e.target===lb)closeLb();});
  document.addEventListener('keydown',e=>{if(e.key==='Escape')closeLb();});
  /* ---- tab panels: one section on screen at a time ---- */
  const panels=[...document.querySelectorAll('.panel')];
  const tabs=[...document.querySelectorAll('[data-go]')];
  const ids=panels.map(p=>p.id);
  function showPanel(id){
    const p=document.getElementById(ids.indexOf(id)>-1?id:'top');
    panels.forEach(x=>x.classList.toggle('on',x===p));
    tabs.forEach(t=>t.setAttribute('aria-current',t.dataset.go===p.id?'true':'false'));
    /* the first few blocks appear at once; the rest still fade in as you scroll */
    [...p.querySelectorAll('.reveal')].slice(0,8).forEach((el,k)=>{
      el.style.transitionDelay=(Math.min(k,6)*55)+'ms';
      el.classList.add('seen');
    });
    window.scrollTo(0,0);
    const act=document.querySelector('.spinelinks button[aria-current="true"]');
    if(act&&act.scrollIntoView) act.scrollIntoView({block:'nearest',inline:'nearest'});
    if(history.replaceState) history.replaceState(null,'','#'+p.id);
  }
  tabs.forEach(b=>b.addEventListener('click',()=>showPanel(b.dataset.go)));
  window.addEventListener('hashchange',()=>showPanel((location.hash||'').slice(1)||'top'));
  showPanel((location.hash||'').slice(1)||'top');
  const io=new IntersectionObserver(es=>es.forEach(e=>{
    if(e.isIntersecting){e.target.classList.add('seen');io.unobserve(e.target);}
  }),{threshold:.08,rootMargin:'0px 0px -40px 0px'});
  document.querySelectorAll('.reveal').forEach((el,k)=>{
    el.style.transitionDelay=(Math.min(k%4,3)*60)+'ms';
    io.observe(el);
  });
})();
</script>
</body>
</html>
